Weird Medieval Guys: How to Live, Laugh, Love (and Die) in Dark Times is an art history book about some of the oddities of the Middle Ages, compiled and written by Olivia Swarthout. It was published by Square Peg, an imprint of Penguin Books, in November 2023.
Synopsis
The book is in two parts. The first covers images relating to medieval life and death; the second is a selected bestiary.
